## (d) Duplicate beneficiaries: matching threshold

Pairs of registrations belonging to the same person. Precision = share of matched pairs that are right; recall = share of true pairs found. Records with the same national ID are always matched. Otherwise names must score at least the threshold, be in the same district and of the same sex, and are kept apart if phones differ by more than 1 digit, IDs differ, or ages differ by more than 2 years.
